status: NON_EXECUTABLE -- defines a contract, mutates nothing

owns: normalized historical/operational facts (tokens, CREATE creators, creator funding, direct funders, transfers, migration events, lifecycle/state, Watchtower's own historical detection method and its wt_* tables, existing operation candidate/confirmed state)
MAIN_DB.authority: authoritative source of RECORD for what happened -- NOT authoritative for confidence/verification quality, which is a separate concern
MAIN_DB.status_this_session: UNCHANGED -- zero writes, zero migration, zero pruning, zero redesign

NEW_EVIDENCE_LAYER.authority: answers WHY/HOW STRONGLY a main-DB fact is supported -- does not itself assert new facts, only qualifies existing ones

DISCOVERY_LAYER.authority: produces CANDIDATE-tier intelligence derived from BOTH main-DB facts and new-evidence confidence -- never canonical
DISCOVERY_LAYER.status_this_session: corpus reclassified (non-destructively) under corrected CEX/INFRA semantics

CANONICAL_OPERATION_STATE.authority: SOLE reviewed/authorized operation identity -- the only layer whose output may be treated as ground truth for attribution
CANONICAL_OPERATION_STATE.status_this_session: UNCHANGED -- zero mutation, verified via the 9-address CONFIRMED control check

roles_not_collapsed: confirmed distinct throughout this session's work: main-DB facts (e.g. a transfer_index row) are never treated as themselves confidence-scored; new-evidence confidence (e.g. HIGH/LOW tier) is never treated as itself a candidate family; a candidate family is never treated as canonical without the explicit CONFIRMED-state gate

part2_source_precedence_and_conflicts.scenario: main-DB fact != new raw-verified evidence (concrete example this session: ordinal 3/5's local-predicted creator disagreed with the raw migration-tx signer during B2Z-P2 calibration)
required_behavior_confirmed_already_impl: PRESERVE BOTH -- the local prediction (main-DB-derived) and the raw result are both retained as permanent, separate ledger records (B2Z-P2's RAW_VERIFICATION_NEGATIVE_TERMINAL contract does exactly this)
RECORD CONFLICT -- the disagreement itself is a first-class, durably recorded fact (SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_FAILED_TERMINAL), not silently resolved
CLASSIFY EVIDENCE QUALITY -- B2Z-P3's five-category policy (HIGH/LOW/etc) explicitly exists for this
REVIEW/SELECTIVE VERIFICATION -- the non-executable selective-RPC queue is the mechanism for resolving specific conflicts when warranted
EXPLICIT AUTHORITY RESOLVES CANONICAL INTERPRETATION -- only human review + the CONFIRMED-state gate ever decides which interpretation becomes canonical; this session made zero such decisions
part2_source_precedence_and_conflicts.precedent_already_exists: this precedence model was NOT invented this session -- it is exactly what B2Z-P2C through P2H already implemented and tested (ordinals 8 and 19's RAW_VERIFICATION_NEGATIVE_TERMINAL records). This artifact formalizes it as an explicit, named architectural rule rather than leaving it implicit in the B2Z-specific code.
